rules: Only fixed-source FC220 headers with GPS, plausible nadir-view camera geometry; source conditions are not used
Approximate flat-ground camera footprint intersects at least40m of versioned public motor-road geometry in its10m interior
Current OSM is only a sampling hint; actual2017 road presence and business state require independent image review
Stable hash order; camera centers >=180m apart and no reused matched OSM way ID; this does not establish independent physical assets
Road length, margin and spacing are sampling/duplication criteria, not obstacle-size thresholds
